slides.headline: A HIGH-ENERGY LASER SHOT 3 CARTEL DRONES OUT OF THE SKY
slides.body: The U.S. military fired a high-energy laser near the southern border and took down 3 hostile cartel drones. No bullets. No nets. A beam of light, and all three were gone

slides.headline: USNORTHCOM CALLED THE DRONES HOSTILE
slides.body: USNORTHCOM confirmed the engagement and classified the drones as hostile because they directly threatened American troops and Border Patrol agents on the ground. Hostile means lethal force is authorized

slides.headline: THE LOCATION AND THE CARTEL BEHIND IT ARE STILL CLASSIFIED
slides.body: Officials refused to name the exact border location or identify which cartel sent the drones. What you don't get to know is where this happened and who ordered it.

slides.headline: 3 DRONES. 1 LASER. ZERO BULLETS.
slides.body: Cartels run organized drone programs, using drones to smuggle people and surveil U.S. law enforcement in real time. They track Border Patrol patterns, time crossings to the minute, and guide operatives below.

slides.headline: DIRECTED-ENERGY WEAPONS ARE NOW OFFICIAL U.S. POLICY
slides.body: Directed-energy weapons are now officially part of the military's active response to cartel drone threats along the U.S. southern border. They crossed from classified experiments into real deployment, and you're watching that happen
